description_en: Installs all currently available system MCP services for a specified Data Agent workspace
description_zh: 为指定 Data Agent 工作空间安装全部当前可用的系统 MCP 服务
name: InitWorkspaceSystemMcpServer

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Data Agent workspace for which to initialize system MCP services. The caller must have at least MEMBER permissions on the workspace
parameters.help_zh: 要初始化系统 MCP 服务的 Data Agent 工作空间 ID。调用者至少需要工作空间 MEMBER 权限
parameters.name: workspace_id
